blockers.description: Backend server (Bun, port 3100) crashed during or shortly after submitting a REPL command (bg_add_node). Port 3100 stopped listening entirely. curl to http://localhost:3100/health fails with connection refused. The R process on port 3101 remains alive but is unreachable without the backend bridge. This blocks all node lifecycle assertions (VAL-GUI-008, VAL-GUI-009, VAL-GUI-011, VAL-GUI-012).
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Clicked 'Retry' button — did not resolve. Reloaded page — did not resolve. Verified backend health — port 3100 not listening. The backend process needs to be restarted.

summary: Tested 5 assertions: 1 passed (VAL-GUI-010: WebSocket connection status visible when session is ready), 4 blocked (VAL-GUI-008, VAL-GUI-009, VAL-GUI-011, VAL-GUI-012). The backend server crashed during REPL command execution, making it impossible to test node addition, canvas rendering, detail drawer, and node deletion. The backend needs to be restarted before retrying.
